_what: Camera moves for the demo reel, one entry per narration beat id. Read by scripts/build-demo-video.mjs; a beat that is absent here gets the gentle default push (zoom 1.1, centred).
_how: zoom is the peak factor reached at the end of the beat, eased in with a smoothstep. cx/cy are the focus point in 0..1 of the frame, so 0.5/0.5 is centre and lower cy favours the top of the screen. Frames are captured at 2560x1440 and delivered at 1920x1080, so anything up to about 1.33 still resolves at or above 1:1 — past that it starts to soften.
_rule: Beats that carry a glide of their own get a small move; beats where the point is READING something on screen get the biggest, because legibility is the job.

b01-why._why: the slider sweep is already the motion

b03-input._why: typing and the cut question carry it

b04-run._why: the stream filling in is the motion; do not compete with it

b05-board._why: a long glide down the whole board

b06-skin._why: the ten scores have to be readable

b10-second-face._why: the tiebreaker: a second person, a different garment

b11-honest-limit._why: the whole beat is one sentence of on-screen copy

b12-refuse._why: the honest empty state has to be legible or the self-catch is hearsay

b13-ledger._why: the ledger names each API; that text is the claim

b14-verify._why: the browser is already zoomed to 2x for this beat so the response text is readable; a second crop on top would only lose the left edge where task_id starts

b16-close._why: end calm; let the end card do the work
